**The first beta of 3.0: turn-by-turn is now its own mod.** This mod now only does wireless CarPlay and Android Auto. Your phone's directions on the cluster and HUD are [Phone Turn-by-Turn](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-projection-tbt) (`projection-tbt`), released together with this beta as 1.0.0-beta.1; it works with wired phones too. It needs [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.8](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases) or newer.

## Updating from 2.x: do it in this order

1. **Update this mod to 3.0.0-beta.1 first.**
2. **Then install Phone Turn-by-Turn 1.0.0-beta.1** if you want directions on the cluster and HUD. Installed next to 2.x it turns *this* mod's hooks off (2.x has the same turn-by-turn hooks), so wireless stops until this mod is 3.0.
3. Your turn-by-turn settings come with you: Phone Turn-by-Turn takes over the ones you had in this mod the first time it starts.

**Using the EV models mod (`egmp-aa-ev`)?** Stay on 2.x for now: it isn't ready for 3.0.

## What changes

- Removed: Android Auto's and CarPlay's turns on the cluster and HUD, their settings and the Android Auto library patches (all in Phone Turn-by-Turn now).
- Kept: the CarPlay route-guidance watchdog after the Bluetooth-to-Wi-Fi handover (#51), now working with Phone Turn-by-Turn through a small agreement with no dependency either way ([docs/tbt-contract.md](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/blob/main/docs/tbt-contract.md)).

## What to test

- **This mod alone:** CarPlay and Android Auto connect over Wi-Fi; the car's own navigation keeps the cluster.
- **Both mods:** the next turn shows on the cluster and HUD, and keeps coming after CarPlay's Bluetooth-to-Wi-Fi handover.

## Going back

Remove Phone Turn-by-Turn first, then install 2.2.0-rc.9 (or 2.2.0), which has turn-by-turn built in.

## Known issues

- Not tried on a car yet, and neither is the agreement between the two mods.
